data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Ezhil represents the God of love, fertility, and prosperity. He is often depicted with a bow and arrow, symbolizing his power to bring life and abundance. The name Ezhil carries the meaning “God of love and fertility” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ezhil usually hope their child will grow to embody god of love and fertility and live with faith, good character and purpose.
